Dialogue_Text: "It was night, and the snow covered almost every inch of the land. Only a few rocks could be seen here and there, illuminated by the moonlight. However, there was clearly something else in there. An armored thing, known for its ability to melt through the ice. But its attacks could also smash even the hardest of walls."
Whate'er tha' may be, me axe be ready to kill it, har har! So? Ye ready fer some bloody fun?
Ah, you're interested in that story, yes? The fee is 3,500 gold pieces. Paid in advance, of course.
Right. Let's see what sort of creature is wading through all that snow.
No. I'll pass. At least for now.
Happy hunting, my friend. Let it be a fine lesson.
